name: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
summary: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil is a Darkspear troll mystic dwelling in a cave at Malaka'jin in the southern Stonetalon Mountains. A longtime comrade of Darsok Swiftdagger and the shadow hunter Rokhan, he turns dark voodoo and ritual sorcery against the Horde's local enemies.

sections.title: The Hermit of Malaka'jin
sections.body: Secluded inside an eastern cavern above the camp of Malaka'jin, Jin'Zil practices ancient jungle troll arts away from the coastal home of his tribe. Surrounded by bubbling cauldrons and captive prisoners, he gathers exotic reagents from the crags of the Stonetalon Mountains—such as ram horns, resonite crystals, and fierce stormer hearts—to weave potent blessings and curses in defense of the Horde's mountain encampment.

sections.title: A Trusted Veteran
sections.body: Jin'Zil is no ordinary hedge wizard; he shares a storied history with senior Horde scouts, counting both Darsok Swiftdagger and the renowned shadow hunter Rokhan among his old friends. While Darsok coordinates frontline skirmishes against night elves and harpies, Jin'Zil fights the war spiritually and alchemically, using his forest magic and volatile voodoo to undermine threats before they ever reach the camp gates.

faq.q: Where can I find Witch Doctor Jin'Zil?
faq.answer: He resides inside a cave on the eastern side of Malaka'jin, a Horde settlement nestled in the southern pass of the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What is Jin'Zil's connection to Rokhan and Darsok Swiftdagger?
faq.answer: Jin'Zil is an old, trusted friend to both Darsok Swiftdagger and the shadow hunter Rokhan. Because of these long-standing ties, scouts throughout Stonetalon rely on his magical expertise when dealing with unusual threats.

faq.q: Why does Jin'Zil have prisoners in his cave?
faq.answer: Jin'Zil keeps captive enemies caged within his cavern workshop. As a traditional witch doctor, he employs captives and raw reagents to test curses, divine portents, and craft defensive voodoo for the settlement.

faq.q: What kind of tasks does he give to Horde adventurers?
faq.answer: He sends travelers across Stonetalon to collect mystical components, including creature organs, ram horns, and resonite crystals, using them to concoct defensive wards and powerful blessings for the war effort.

angles.text: Jin'Zil represents traditional Darkspear witch doctor practices transplanted into the rugged wilderness of Kalimdor, maintaining deep ties to prominent figures like Rokhan.
As the Horde secures Stonetalon's southern paths, Jin'Zil provides essential occult defense and intelligence support alongside the outpost's scouts.
